baseline.method: NSTextInputClient.insertText through the native field editor and AppKit textDidChange; includes editing, search, cells/icons/layout. External ScreenCaptureKit observer measures the first changed result-region window frame after the result view commit. Excludes physical keyboard/OS event delivery and monitor photon latency. Capture observer runs outside the app/worker process tree. Hidden/active memory is proc_pid_rusage physical footprint and RSS; parent lifetime peak is exact, combined app+worker peak is sampled every 10ms. Index timing starts after FileIndex initialization.

window_frames.method: NSTextInputClient entry to first changed result-region window frame after result view display/CA commit; region x18...600,y85...135. Excludes keyboard/OS event delivery and photons. Capture cadence/animation/glass composition remain in this measurement; identical visible first-row pixels can delay change detection.

measurement_notes: Primary UI run used reverse order optimized then baseline, no other benchmark/compile/test processes active. Earlier concurrent compiler UI run discarded.
Window frames fingerprint an existing result-row area; no visual marker or production UI change. Excludes keyboard/OS event delivery, IME composition time, display photons and animation settling.
10ms combined app+worker peak uses proc_listchildpids count (not byte count), checked against live child process.
Index builds start from empty databases and finish all 100000 document bodies; filesystem caches are warm. Includes native snapshot preparation.
Index timer begins after FileIndex constructor; parent lifetime physical-footprint peak includes constructor. Combined peak sampling begins in AppPerformance.start.
Capture observer is external to app/worker tree. RSS includes shared/clean mapped pages; physical footprint is separately reported. Single hardware/workload comparison, not proof of a global optimum.

verification.system_metadata_fixture_match: not exposed by host system index; importer passed
verification.sanitizers: ASan + UBSan core and optimization cases

implementation: Progressive ArgusSearch read snapshot and small rank records; SQLite statement reuse; winner-only string materialization.
Versioned positional CJK body tokenizer and compact persisted position-to-source-byte maps; eager snippets preserve existing scrolling UX.
Read-only mapped metadata snapshot with adaptive dense/sparse postings, interned parent paths/strings, generation+UUID validation, SHA-256 payload validation and SQL fallback.
Disk-spooled filename jobs and row-ID cursor for pending bodies; constant-time row count; mtime/size validation before accepting extraction.
Atomic schema extension and fulltext migration; interruption and rollback preserve usable SQLite path. Builder arenas freed before snapshot pages are loaded.
Benchmark instrumentation only in ARGUS_BENCHMARK; production UI/animation sources unchanged.
